checked_scope: scripts/revd_trial_gate.py: evidence schemas, source/input/output binding, positive and negative acceptance
dv/revd/gate_test.py: negative-test fault isolation and missing coverage
dv/revd/d2_runner.py: genuine compile/simulation, dense independent golden, counters and source identities
dv/revd/d2_protocol.py: reset/fault/continuous and real RTL mutation construction
dv/revd/core_tb.sv: public input/output use, handshake stability, unknown values, final handshakes, passive counters

blocking_findings.problem: Positive D1 command validation filters mutation_ paths, while actual D1 command paths use mutant_. All four intentionally failing vvp executions remain in the positive list and reject a genuinely passing D1 manifest.
blocking_findings.evidence: d1_filter_probe.json: current completed D1 GREEN fixture rejected with nonzero/timeout subprocess; four mutant vvp exit1 records remain
blocking_findings.fix: Classify positive and expected-failure subprocesses from explicit mutation records; separately verify every mutation compile succeeds and simulator fails for the recorded expected reason.

blocking_findings.problem: check_hashes only requires a nonempty mapping. validate_case accepts a source inventory containing numeric/fixedpoint.py alone, omitting all RTL, TB and runner identities. This loses the required current-source and newly untracked-code binding of each run.
blocking_findings.evidence: probe_result.json: incomplete_source_inventory accepted=true using a copy of a current-source real full36 PASS run
blocking_findings.fix: Require the exact mandatory source/input/output inventory for the run type; reject omitted and unexpected entries. Bind protocol producer source at summary or case level as well. Add a deletion-of-required-entry gate negative.

blocking_findings.problem: Only executable names are checked. The stored compiler argv can be changed to iverilog --help without rejection. read_latency can be changed from1 to2 while actual compile -Pcore_tb.READ_LATENCY remains1; consequently the latency2 acceptance path can claim a rerun with no two-cycle build.
blocking_findings.evidence: probe_result.json: compiler_argv_not_bound and read_latency_metadata_mismatch both accepted=true
blocking_findings.fix: Validate compiler top, geometry/PM/read-latency parameters, exact compiled RTL/TB paths, expected mutation defines and output executable; validate simulator executable and CMD/OUT/STATS paths. Require an independently named/read-latency2 run whose actual compile uses2.

blocking_findings.problem: The gate parses TASK counters but never parses or validates actual per-bank X/W CE records, and never reconciles receipt counters/banks/task_counters with stats.txt. A receipt claiming effective_macs=-1 and banks={} passes; deleting every actual bank CE line and updating the stats file hash also passes.
blocking_findings.evidence: probe_result.json: counter_receipt_unbound and missing_actual_bank_ce_evidence both accepted=true
blocking_findings.fix: Require complete per-task/per-bank CE records with distinct valid bank IDs, expected read/write sums and correct task grouping; derive and compare task_counters/counters/banks from stats. Add missing-bank and corrupt-counter negatives.

additional_findings.problem: Protocol summary has no producer source hash, case manifests hash d2_runner/core TB/RTL but omit d2_protocol.py. The final source inventory proves what the suite is now, while historical protocol runs are not explicitly bound to that producer version. Protocol acceptance also trusts case names and expected override records rather than reconstructing the directed scenario.
additional_findings.fix: Bind the protocol producer and suite configuration to the summary, and verify required reset/fault/continuous markers or reconstruct expected directed-stream identities.

additional_findings.problem: At least5 case records does not prove the required M1/3/4/5, N16/32 and PM2/PM4 small-geometry coverage. The current runner generates the intended set, but the gate could accept five duplicates.
additional_findings.fix: Validate the required geometry tuples and unique case paths/identities, not only count.

additional_findings.problem: The gate-negative receipt only needs exit_code0, negative_tests>=10 and an existing log path; log contents/hash, actual unittest success, missing/failed/skipped tests and script/source identity are not rechecked.
additional_findings.fix: Bind receipt command/tool/source/log hash and verify the actual test summary contains the expected positive and required rejection cases with no failure/error/skip.

additional_findings.problem: identity already verifies baseline ancestry, but evaluate adds exact HEAD==launch baseline_commit. The requested new gate uses baseline ancestry; preserving the current session HEAD is a separate no-Git-change invariant.
additional_findings.fix: Use identity ancestry for the durable baseline rule and compare against the captured run-start HEAD for this session's no-Git-change check.

positive_observations: D2 runner genuinely invokes Icarus compile and vvp simulation with exit codes and completion marker; no missing-tool success substitution was found.
Dense golden uses the pinned numeric ffn1_reference and mathematical indices independent of DUT bank/scheduler address code.
Core TB drives only public input events; no private RAM preload, internal force or answer feedback was found.
Blocked-output payload/valid, unknown outputs, unique/index/flags/last and post-handshake done are checked by TB/scoreboard.
Protocol tests construct real reset/fault/continuous runs and actual compilable MUT_DROP_K63/MUT_UNSIGNED RTL builds; these are not mislabeled software-only mutations.
evidence_scope: Software gate probes on copies of a completed real RTL run plus static source inspection. No new RTL simulation or production rerun was claimed by this review.
note: Review is bound to source_sha256 above. In-progress stubs and older unfinished status files are not treated as final implementation failures. Root may fix findings and request a fresh review.
